description: This file defines a utility class 'SessionUtil' that provides methods to get, set, and remove session attributes in a web application using HttpServletRequest.

classes.name: SessionUtil
classes.description: A utility class for managing session attributes in a web application.

methods.name: getSessionAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a session attribute by key, cast to a specified type.

methods.name: removeSessionAttribute
methods.description: Removes a session attribute identified by key.

methods.name: setSessionAttribute
methods.description: Sets a session attribute with a specified key and value.
